object_description: compact six-storey volume with a transparent central foyer and sunken courtyard
design_condition: The building is set back to create a public entrance space and forms a new urban composition with neighboring buildings, while the sunken courtyard accommodates lit basement spaces.

positive.statement: The public space creates an appealing entrance situation for the school building and the neighboring tower.

position.rationale: Setback and entrance are constrained along the southern edge of the tall sampled volume.

positive.statement: The spacious and transparent foyer provides good orientation and clarity.

position.rationale: Central vertical opening is suggested by the footprint and elevation discontinuities.

positive.statement: The central staircase connects all floors and simultaneously creates an open communication zone.

position.rationale: The staircase is anchored within the central core, but individual stair geometry is not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The classrooms are clearly structured, flexibly usable, and have well-dimensioned and well-lit access zones.

position.rationale: Upper perimeter floors provide a plausible classroom anchor; internal daylight zones are not directly visible.

positive.statement: The learning islands are correctly arranged and well dimensioned, creating interior connections and interesting spatial structures.

position.rationale: Interior placement is approximated beside the central core, without distinguishable island geometry.

positive.statement: The load-bearing system provides a high degree of flexibility for all functional areas.

position.rationale: Regular vertical and horizontal sampling suggests structural organization, but members are not individually identifiable.

positive.statement: The project impresses with its high functionality and structure.

position.rationale: Tall compact mass and central opening are clearly visible across the calibrated views.

negative.statement: The quality of the new situation is somewhat diminished by the proximity of the school building to the tower block.
